title: PR #214: Add competitive monitoring baseline and 2026-10-21 snapshot
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

Adds the 2026-10-21 evidence-based report and registry snapshot v0.2.2 (14 provider/product lines, 14 ADD/UPDATE deltas) alongside the 2026-10-19 baseline. The v0.2.2 registry supersedes the same-day v0.2.1 file and corrects baseline classifications/delta semantics. Bubble's official 2026-10-20 price transition is recorded as STATUS_CHANGED; Linux mainline 7.3 remains separate from stable 6.18.y. Missing/conflicting evidence is UNVERIFIED. This is a targeted review, not a full market census. The PR remains Draft and unmerged; daily automation/comparison logic is not implemented.
